title: Reflection with Action-Induced Visual Differences for Desktop GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.24015v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Planner-Operator-Reflector (POR) framework is widely used in GUI agents to maintain objective alignment in complex tasks through modular collaboration. However, desktop GUIs introduce a key challenge: large, dense interfaces often exhibit subtle or scattered state changes, placing most of the burden on the reflector, which must compare pre- and post-action screens, while the planner and operator reason over a single state. Existing reflectors collapse change detection and outcome verification into one step, leaving evidence implicit and yielding weakly grounded decisions. To address this limitation, we propose Evidence-First Reflection (EFR), a two-stage reflector that explicitly decouples action-induced visual differences extraction from outcome verification. translated_title: 面向桌面GUI代理的基于行动诱导视觉差异的反思机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24015v1 公告类型：新 摘要：规划者-操作者-反思者（POR）框架在GUI代理中被广泛使用，通过模块化协作在复杂任务中保持目标一致性。然而，桌面GUI引入了一个关键挑战：大型、密集的界面通常表现出细微或分散的状态变化，这给反思者带来了大部分负担，因为它必须比较行动前后的屏幕，而规划者和操作者则基于单一状态进行推理。现有的反思者将变更检测和结果验证合并为一步，导致证据隐含且决策依据薄弱。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了证据优先反思（EFR），这是一种两阶段反思机制，明确将行动诱导的视觉差异提取与结果验证解耦。EFR通过集合标记注释识别行动位置和候选变更区域，描述并筛选与行动相关的变更，并据此做出最终判断。
tldr: 本文提出证据优先反思（EFR）方法，通过两阶段解耦行动诱导视觉差异提取与结果验证，增强了桌面GUI代理中反思机制的决策依据和可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Evidence-First Reflection (EFR), a two-stage method that decouples action-induced visual difference extraction from outcome verification, enhancing the grounding and reliability of reflection in desktop GUI agents.
